## 2026-09-01

### Impact

- Users who authenticate through Okta and rely on the Okta Verify app can now be redirected into it during the auth flow.

### Changes

- Allowlist `okta.com` for native intent launches so the Okta Verify app opens correctly during universal-link handoff

### Products

- Deposit

### Requirements

#### Latest

| Name       | Compatible | Build Version |
| ---------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin     | 2.0+       | 2.1.21        |
| Gradle     | 8.11.1+    | 8.14.2        |
| AGP        | 8.9+       | 8.9.1         |
| Min SDK    | 23         | 23            |
| Target SDK | 35         | 35            |

#### Legacy (`-kotlin1.9`)

| Name       | Compatible | Build Version |
| ---------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin     | 1.9.x      | 1.9.25        |
| Gradle     | 8.0+       | 8.7           |
| AGP        | 8.1 - 8.5  | 8.1.4         |
| Min SDK    | 23         | 23            |
| Target SDK | 35         | 35            |
